quadros: WIDE STRIDE, near leg in front: the lighter near heel touches the ground far in front of him, the darker far leg stretched far behind on its toes; body at its lowest.
DOWN: the near foot is flat and takes the weight with the knee bent, the darker far foot leaves the ground behind him, knee bent, swinging forward.
LEGS TOGETHER: both legs almost straight and side by side under his hips, feet together (the darker far foot slightly lifted next to the near ankle); the narrowest silhouette, body at its highest.
WIDE STRIDE, far leg in front: the darker far heel touches the ground far in front of him, the lighter near leg stretched far behind on its toes; body at its lowest (frame 1 with the legs swapped).
DOWN: the far foot is flat and takes the weight, the lighter near foot leaves the ground behind him, knee bent, swinging forward (frame 2 with the legs swapped).
LEGS TOGETHER again: both legs straight and side by side under his hips, feet together; the narrowest silhouette; ready to loop to frame 1.
imagens.acao: A calm, confident fighter's walk cycle forward, drawn IN PLACE, upright posture, both fists held up near the chin in a boxing guard the whole time (the arms barely move). The LEGS make the difference between frames: frames 1 and 4 are the WIDEST stride, frames 3 and 6 are the NARROWEST pose with the legs straight and together. The far leg is drawn slightly darker. TOP ROW = the NEAR (lighter) leg steps forward; BOTTOM ROW = the FAR (darker) leg steps forward
imagens.extra: Cap firmly on, guard steady, calm focused face.

quadros: CONTACT, near leg: the near foot lands flat right under his hips, near knee slightly bent; the far leg is behind, bent, heel rising; the FAR arm swings forward (fist at chin height), the NEAR arm swings back (elbow behind the body).

PUSH-OFF, near leg: the near leg is straight behind him, pushing off the toes; the far knee drives forward and up to hip height; body is one straight diagonal line from the back foot to the head; arms at full swing, far arm forward.
FLIGHT: both feet clearly off the ground; the far knee is high in front (thigh horizontal), the near heel kicks up behind toward the buttocks; arms switching, both elbows close to the body.
CONTACT, far leg: the darker FAR foot is the one planted under his hips; the lighter NEAR leg is now the back leg, bent, heel rising; the NEAR arm (with the watch) swings forward, the far arm back.
PUSH-OFF, far leg: the darker FAR leg is straight behind him pushing off the toes; the lighter NEAR knee drives forward and up to hip height; near arm (with the watch) forward.
FLIGHT: both feet off the ground; the lighter NEAR knee is high in front, the darker far heel kicks up behind; ready to loop to frame 1.
imagens.acao: An all-out sprint cycle like a professional 100 m runner, drawn IN PLACE, body leaning forward, arms pumping hard with elbows bent at 90 degrees, hands as loose fists. The far leg and far arm are drawn slightly darker and partly hidden behind the body. TOP ROW = the NEAR (lighter) leg leads; BOTTOM ROW = the FAR (darker) leg leads, so the bottom row must NOT copy the top row
imagens.extra: Cap firmly on, tank top fluttering slightly.
